headline: PPI 6.3%, 10y lower Thursday, Dec hike odds 90%, Kospi -14.5% on week, Brent $105.2 overnight
stance: PPI 6.3% Thursday and the 10y still closed lower: the AI unwind outbid inflation. December hike odds ~90%, October ~30%; Warsh gave no steer before the blackout.

news.head: CoreWeave +5.9% Thursday after Nvidia CEO backing
news.body: Huang: "strength improving every day", no backstop needed. Stock -4% pre-market (~5am ET); 2031 bonds still near 15%.

news.head: Schwab revenue $7.17bn, a hair light; stock -2.7%
news.body: Adjusted EPS $1.69 vs $1.65 est, record $190bn net new assets. 2026 revenue guided to the low end of the range.

news.head: Penske Automotive taken private at $212, +8.8%
news.body: Penske Corp and Mitsui pay about $16.3bn enterprise value, an 8.8% premium. Dealer peers rose with it Thursday.

news.head: PNC, US Bancorp beat on EPS, missed on NII
news.body: Both ahead of estimates on earnings Thursday, both short on net interest income. PNC -0.4%, US Bancorp +2%.

implications: Hot PPI, lower yields: the Treasury bid is risk-off, not disinflation. It reverses if AI equities find a floor, so the 10y tracks the Nasdaq this week.
Core PPI 0.7% m/m with retail control +0.1%: prices hot, volumes soft. That mix argues for a December hike and a lower terminal, not an October move.

watch.head: Industrial production, 9:15am
watch.body: Consensus +0.4% m/m after flat in August. Import and export prices at 8:30am.

watch.head: Travelers, Citizens Financial report before the open
watch.body: Regional NII after two misses Thursday; insurer cat losses and reserve releases.

watch.head: Fed blackout from Saturday; FOMC, Oct 28
watch.body: Warsh in Bangkok was the last word: no prejudging meetings. October hike ~30%, December ~90% (~5am ET).

watch.head: Weekend risk: Iran, midterms Nov 3
watch.body: Trump floated more military action against Iran after Nov 3. 12 vessels hit near Hormuz Oct 5-11.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: December hike odds ~90% (~5am ET), from 67% Thursday morning; October ~30%. PPI 6.3% y/y moved the second hike, not the first.
Thursday's 10y fall was the largest since Aug 2025, into a 1.3% m/m PPI. Haven bid out of AI equities, not disinflation.
Brent $105.2, -0.7% (~6am ET). Hormuz flows 11.6m b/d week to Oct 13, 68% of baseline; 100m bbl of reserves accelerated, 20m of it diesel.
sections.positioning: COT, Oct 6: Ultra Bond specs extended long at the 88th percentile, new this week, up 25 points. Fast money was long the long end before Thursday's rally.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: 378 of 500 S&P names rose Thursday while SOX fell a seventh straight day. Rotation into defensives, not de-risking.
Kospi +2.05% overnight after -7.6% Thursday; -14.5% on the week, worst since Oct 2008. 20 top AI and chip names lost over $1tn this week.
Futures (~5am ET): S&P +0.2%, Nasdaq 100 flat, Dow +0.3%. Indonesia -11.6%, largest fall since 1998, on a proposed MSCI standalone reclassification.
sections.positioning: COT, Oct 6: VIX specs extended short at the 10th percentile, new this week, down 8 points. Nasdaq 100 longs at the 100th percentile, third week.

single_name.note: Star Bulk Carriers: 2 insider-buy rules fired, latest filing Oct 14, trading above its 200-day. Days to cover 1.4. Long setup, score 5 of 5.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: 5y CDS on the largest AI-cloud borrower hit 1,195bp intraday Thursday, a record; 881bp Monday. Implied 5-year default odds above 60%.
Three regionals beat on EPS Thursday, all three short on NII. Margin, not credit, is the bank-earnings problem into a hiking Fed.
10y muni yield -16bp Thursday to 3.74%, largest drop in 18 months. The Treasury bid reached every long-duration market, not just governments.
sections.positioning: Dealers' HY inventory still at the 99th percentile of 3 years, second week. Standing background, not new.
